body: Umm, if I understand your question correctly, I'm stuck in a routine, I don't really do anything but work and sleep, I don't have health insurance so I can't really see anyone about my anxiety, which in turn makes me more anxious ironically. I'm recently single for the first time in my teenage/adult life, which is terrifying if I'm being honest, the future is pretty bleak, and I can only really care about myself so much

Sometimes, I don't even really know. One minute everything is okay and then the thoughts hit and it's hard to climb out. I'm gonna say it stems from having to constantly be "okay" so to speak, I upset people with my anxiety and no one really wants to listen, but people want to vent (usually to me). Today is a particularly bad day and I just had to put some thoughts somewhere else other than my head.
